opportunities.idea: Rank and lineage tension (yeoman versus royal) as a social system the player navigates.

basis_refs.q: I bade thee remember that thou wert a King's son and I a yeoman's daughter

ledger.summary: Ralph, Ursula, the Sage and Michael-a-dale ride across the plain, meeting few and mild folk, and one afternoon see Whitwall's towers far off. Ursula grows shy: near Ralph's home she fears high-born kin will scorn a yeoman's daughter, and says Ralph is now fit for the Kaiser's throne. Ralph recounts their deeds and swears by his sword that if his kin do not honour her he will leave his land and found a new kindred with her. He foretells that her beauty will cause strife that his Well-touched blade will settle. It is late spring.
ledger.geography_notes: The plain west of the mountains to Whitwall: a dry highway between meadows and plough-land, Whitwall's towers and pinnacles seen far off in the afternoon.
